data.reportText: Apple Inc. Common Stock is expected* to report earnings on  11/02/2026 after market close.  The report will be for the fiscal Quarter ending Sep 2026.  According to Zacks Investment Research, based on  7 analysts'  forecasts, the consensus EPS forecast for the quarter is $1.99.  The reported EPS for the same quarter last year was $1.85.
data.heading: AAPL Earnings Date

text: AAPL has a "high" Earnings Quality Ranking (EQR) for the 19th consecutive week. Earnings quality refers to the extent to which current earnings predict future earnings. "High-quality" earnings are expected to persist, while "low-quality" earnings do not. EQR is a weekly ranking of relative earnings quality for a large universe of publicly traded US equities. Companies are compared to peers in their industry. Find out more about EQR data.
